description: This file defines the FileStream class, an interface for asynchronous and synchronous file I/O operations, including open, close, read, write, seek, get file info, and flush functionalities.

classes.name: net::FileStream
classes.description: A class providing an interface for file I/O operations, supporting asynchronous and synchronous methods for opening, closing, reading, writing, seeking, retrieving info, and flushing files.

methods.name: FileStream
methods.description: Constructors for initializing FileStream with or without an already opened file, using a task runner for async operations.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Asynchronously opens a file with specified flags, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file asynchronously, invoking a callback when done.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file stream is currently open.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Adjusts the read/write position in the file asynchronously.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously from the current position into a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data asynchronously from a buffer to the current position.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Forces a filesystem sync on the file asynchronously.
